method: exact arithmetic; Wilson score interval from axbench.stats.wilson

proposed_heldout_evaluation_size.basis: at least 30 per supported operation and 10 per CLARIFY or REJECT reason; the owner decides the final numbers (HELDOUT_AUTHORING_KIT.md)

proposed_review_sizes.second_review_also: every row a first reviewer marks gold_correct no or serious_error yes

zero_failure_sample_size.meaning: with zero failures in n reviewed rows, the one-sided 95% upper bound of the failure rate is at most the stated rate; any failure needs a larger sample
